title: Simulated Replications as a Methodological Tool in Social Science Research

contributions.purpose: 检验模拟数据能否复现已发表社会科学实验结果
contributions.mechanism: 用 AI 驱动流程(Liner Panel Agent)生成 240 名模拟被试,复现 Hong et al. 2024 关于创作者/影响者种族线索的 2x2 实验
contributions.evaluation: 部分复现:创作者种族对可信度主效应复现且放大(F=52.62,p<.001);影响者种族效应消失;评价/参与效应被夸大
contributions.domain: 计算社会科学/传播学方法论
contributions.source_quote: This study demonstrates the potential and limitations of simulated data by replicating a published experiment on race cues in mediated communication.

contributions.purpose: 刻画模拟方法的适用边界
contributions.mechanism: 对比人类样本与 AI 样本的效应量方向与大小(convergent/divergent 分类)
contributions.evaluation: 强稳健效应可恢复(可信度均差 0.70 vs 原 0.35);细微情境依赖效应丢失(影响者种族均差 -0.01 vs 原 0.35)
contributions.source_quote: strong effects may be recoverable, but subtle, context-dependent differences may be lost

contributions.purpose: 为社会科学定位模拟方法的角色
contributions.mechanism: 论证模拟可作复现工具、理论探针、实验设计早期验证三种用途,主张人机混合流程
contributions.evaluation: 无独立量化评估,属方法论立场归纳
contributions.source_quote: simulation offers a pathway for accelerating theory testing, replication, and methodological innovation in social science research

self_declared_provenance.quote: the present study conducted a simulation-based replication of Hong et al. [2024], who examined how racial cues influence perceptions of credibility, evaluation, and engagement in mediated communication
Dependent variables were adapted directly from Hong et al. [2024]
the original survey instrument, modeled on Hong et al. [2024], was uploaded in PDF format to the Panel Agent interface

notes: 实证方法论论文,四元组适配良好。核心贡献本身即负结果/平局:明确报告 partial replication，模拟夸大显著身份线索效应(评价均差 0.53 vs 原 0.37、参与 0.26 vs 原 null),同时抹除细微情境效应(影响者种族效应消失)。整篇是对 Hong et al. 2024 人类实验的模拟复刻,强嫁接来源。代码/模拟数据未开源(checklist 自承 No)。所用工具为商用 Liner Research Agents,复现透明度受限。
